THE COLOSSEUM IS AN ELLIPSE AND THIS IS A CIRCLE, which is the honest limit of the kit here. `arrangeOn` offers a circle and an arc, not an ellipse; a 189 x 156 m ellipse has an eccentricity a viewer can see. The radius used is the mean of the two semi-axes (86.25 m), so the building is the right size and the wrong shape by about 10 % on each axis. An ellipse would be a real addition to `spex-build` and is the first thing this site would ask for.

Three arcades of eighty arches: the number 80 is the building's own and is what the shot is about, so the scale was chosen to carry it rather than the other way round.
